🧬 ELI5 Kata · Game of Life in Reverse (Factor, 1 kyu)

Stepping Conway's Game of Life forward is easy, but how do you run time BACKWARDS to find a predecessor (or prove a pattern is a Garden of Eden)?

https://github.com/8b-is/space-bender/tree/main/katas/1kyu/game-of-life-in-reverse

🎯 ELI5 Step 1 (Interval Feasibility Bounds):

Each cell tracks its placed live neighbors `c` and remaining unplaced neighbors `r`.
• Need 1 next gen? Valid iff `c <= 3` and `c + r + s >= 3`
• Need 0 next gen? Valid iff `c + s < 3` or `c + r > 3`
Dead branches prune immediately!

🪟 ELI5 Step 2 (4-Bit Sliding Frontier Profile DP):

In raster order, only the last `W + 1` cells still touch future cells.
Packing `(min(c, 4), s)` into 4 bits per frontier cell gives one integer key cached in a Factor hash-set (`?adjoin`), never repeating dead-ends!

✅ Verified across 55 grids + Garden of Eden in Factor 0.102!
